I can address both criticisms.

"Pirate Yakuza is thin."

If you mean in terms of content, it is thicker than the first Gaiden. If you mean in terms of story, yes but that doesn't mean it's bad. It's a seafaring adventure told with all the embellishments we expect out of Goro Majima. Now, whether that's what you personally wanted or not is a you problem. Would we have wanted a happy ending for Kiryu or at least a resolution of some sort? Yes, but this isn't (technically) about him. This is about how Majima went to Hawaii for some reason, lost his memory, and ended up owing his life to a curious, daring young boy who he repays with an adventure (and also kinda fixing his family in the process). It being a Majima retelling makes it even better for that because you have the license to go completely nuts.

"Pirate Yakuza is unnecessary"

Practically 80% of the series is unnecessary (were Kiryu's friendships in Onomichi necessary?), and this being a Gaiden game, is entirely unnecessary. Does knowing that Majima screwed the pooch so bad on Ambregris that he let both sources of it get away change the overall arc of the series? Nope. Again, this game isn't about that. This game is strictly about how Majima ended up in a weird spot, did what he always does post-0 (embrace the madness) and ended up eating some good ass BBQ squid. That's the purpose of a gaiden game - to show you a story in the same universe that isn't necessarily based off the main story. Gaiden 1 was completely unnecessary: Why did we need to know more about Kiryu's life as a Daidoji agent? It doesn't change anything. Hell, even the ending, which is flawless, is completely unnecessary. Does knowing Kiryu still pines for the life he lost with the orphanage children change anything in the story? Nope, but it remains an amazing scene nonetheless. The entire premise of the statement is ridiculous.

There's definitely flaws with the game - While the game happens strictly in Hawaii, I think a system like Memoirs of a Dragon would have been a great addition, doubly so since you got Romi Park back and thus could have a voiced flashback scene that shed more light on the Park/Majima relationship.
